from: June book, night 28 (Keep Your Heart Close)
p1: When the temple was done, the Lord came to Solomon again. The Lord was Jesus. He said, “I have heard your prayer.”
He said, “I have made this house holy for My name forever. My eyes and My heart will always be there.”
He told Solomon to walk with Him with a good heart, like David. Then Solomon’s family would always have a king.
p2: But when Solomon was old, he let his heart turn away from the Lord. That was a sad choice. Every day, we can choose to keep our hearts close to the Lord.
Tonight, put your hand on your heart. Jesus loves you, and He will help your heart stay close to Him.
old: After the beautiful temple was built, Heavenly Father appeared to Solomon again. He had something very important to tell him.
Heavenly Father said, “Solomon, if you keep My commandments and follow Me, you and your family will be blessed forever! But if you turn away and worship other gods, things will go badly.”
This was a big promise — and a big warning! Heavenly Father wanted Solomon to keep his heart close to Him. Even kings need to obey God!
Sadly, when Solomon got older, he didn’t always follow Heavenly Father. He started worshiping other gods. We must always keep our hearts close to Heavenly Father — every day, our whole life!
